about: imagestep#475 / #479 — one list of addresses an outbound fetch must refuse and must allow, for every copy of the rule (ledger C52): the service's WebhookTargetGuard and the MCP server's safe-url.js. IPv6 entries are the address as a resolver hands it over; a test that builds an InetAddress from one builds an Inet6Address, so a v4-mapped entry is not quietly turned into an IPv4 one first.
